# Chart model captures

Seven frozen sources cover all twelve chart kinds, typed and retained data,
category and series tables, every label-position alias, legend normalization,
colors, chart and plot styling, gridlines, integer gap/overlap values, property
overrides and Lua constructors fed by a resolved JSON resource. Source and asset
hashes protect the capture inputs.

These are complete evaluated-model captures. Chart data is retained without
plotting coercions at this layer. Editable packages, native rendering and Office
review are separate capabilities and are not established by these captures.
